name: zetetic-autopilot
description: Automatic effort and model: every request runs at the effort its grade calls for (zetetic-genius) and the tool loop steps down the ladder; subagents run on the family their type and the turn's class call for (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable); under quota or context pressure everything goes one notch down and long streaming tool results keep head and tail. Starts in observe.

policy_mode.title: Policy mode
policy_mode.description: observe: every effort, model and lean decision is logged (the cockpit's POLICY panel) and not applied. enforce: applied as logged.

quota_pressure_percent.title: Quota pressure (% of the five-hour window)
quota_pressure_percent.description: At or past this share of the five-hour window, requests run at low effort, heavy subagents are spawned on sonnet and main drops to sonnet.

result_cap_chars.title: Tool result cap (characters)
result_cap_chars.description: A Bash, Grep, Glob, WebFetch or WebSearch result longer than this keeps its head and tail; the cut is named in the row.
